summary.en: Integers written out in Brazilian Portuguese (por extenso).
summary.pt-BR: Números inteiros escritos por extenso em português.

convertToWords.summary: Formats an integer as its Brazilian Portuguese cardinal number words ("por extenso"), e.g. `1235` becomes `"mil duzentos e trinta e cinco"`.
description: Writes an integer in Brazilian Portuguese cardinal words ("por extenso"), e.g. 1235 is "mil duzentos e trinta e cinco".
- Accepts integers from -999 999 999 999 999 to 999 999 999 999 999; a non-integer is truncated toward zero; a negative number is prefixed with "menos".
- `options` selects the grammatical gender (default masculine), which agrees "um/uma", "dois/duas" and the hundreds.
- Returns an empty string for a value outside that range or not finite.

tests.name: truncates-fraction
tests.note: the fractional part is dropped; asserted by the reference (JS) unit tests
